messages:
Maya (AE): hey team — BeaconPay wants a short pilot to swap their vendor to Redwood with minimal changes. they asked if we can accept their existing API payloads as-is and return compatible responses.
Ethan (Sales Eng): high-level asks: 1) minimal adapter so engineers change little 2) clear migration pricing for overlap runs 3) security checklist for enterprise POCs
Rina (Solutions Eng): can do an adapter proxy that maps their /api/v2/respond -> our /v1/chat/completions. need sample request/response schema to validate edge cases (attachments, streaming, custom stop tokens).
Maya (AE): pasted their example: 
```json
{
  "req_id":"sess-77",
  "payload":"Explain the refund policy",
  "engine":"neo-pro-2023",
  "limit":256,
  "return_stream":false
}
```
Rina (Solutions Eng): main tech deltas: tokenization differences, default temperature/stop logic, and how we handle multi-turn context. we can add a normalization phase to rewrite prompts and a compatibility token mapping.
Ethan (Sales Eng): they asked for "response parity" for 85% of cases during the POC. can we commit to a number?
Rina (Solutions Eng): we can commit to an eval-driven target: run their 300 canonical prompts, compute semantic-similarity and exact-match buckets. aim for >=85% similarity on high-priority prompts. will include reranker or small prompt shim to boost parity.
Sam (Security): security asks: BYOK, tenant isolation, VPC peering for staging, and raw prompt redaction. Dedicated staging will work. also need to know what logs we keep and purge timeline.
Priya (Finance): pricing note: overlap billing while dual-running is common. suggest offering a migration credit: first 200k tokens from Redwood free for 45 days, then normal billing. will need approval if they want more.
Maya (AE): customer also requested an NDA addendum for sample prompts and a 14-day auto-delete for POC logs. ok?
Sam (Security): 14-day purge for raw prompts is OK for POC if we store encrypted-at-rest and document retention flow. legal will need the data flow diagram.
Rina (Solutions Eng): tech plan (short):
- adapter proxy: header + body mapping, 1:1 for common fields
- prompt normalization: strip vendor meta, unify tokenization boundaries
- optional rerank step: run 3 candidate completions, pick nearest to vendor baseline
- eval harness: side-by-side diffs, cosine sim on embeddings, and a small human review set
- metrics: similarity, token delta, latency delta

Example adapter snippet we can ship:
```yaml
routes:
  - from: /api/v2/respond
    to: /v1/chat/completions
    map:
      body.payload: body.input
      body.limit: body.max_tokens
      query.engine: header.x-engine
```

Rina (Solutions Eng): estimate: 1 senior SE + 1 backend eng ~10 business days for POC adapter + harness. shorter if they send a narrow prompt subset.
Ethan (Sales Eng): customer timeline preference: 3-week pilot with weekly checkpoints. they want a smoke test by day 3. can we deliver that?
Rina (Solutions Eng): yes — smoke adapter + sample curl for day 3, full harness by week 2.
Priya (Finance): will draft the token credit proposal and approval route. Maya, share projected ARR influence for this deal so I can prioritize.
Maya (AE): I'll add numbers in the deal doc. also can we include a note that we won't promise exact token-for-token parity — behavior differences possible.
Rina (Solutions Eng): we'll avoid absolute promises. propose SLA: maintainable parity target measured by the eval harness and iterative tuning.
Sam (Security): blockers list: BYOK integration timeline (customer KMS cert exchange), VPC peering window (need network team), and legal NDA for prompts.
deploy-bot: staging-dedicated-02 scheduled for provisioning at 2024-04-02T14:00Z
Maya (AE): action items: 1) request sample prompts + vendor baseline responses 2) send token credit proposal to BeaconPay 3) Rina to produce smoke adapter + curl 4) Sam to send POC security checklist 5) Priya to start credit approval flow
Ethan (Sales Eng): I'll put together the presales runbook and include the smoke curl and short troubleshooting steps.
Rina (Solutions Eng): I'll push an initial branch tonight with the proxy skeleton and README for normalization rules. will attach a minimal test suite.
Sam (Security): I'll compile the POC security FAQ (BYOK steps, allowed IP ranges, audit log retention) and post it here.
Maya (AE): ok team — I'll email BeaconPay with the proposed 3-week timeline and get their sample set. don't promise 100% parity.
Ethan (Sales Eng): agreed. I'll lead the weekly demo cadence with BeaconPay engineers. :calendar:
Maya (AE): thanks all — will update when I have the sample data.
